Example inputs for plot_sv_reconstruction(): a complex CDK4 amplicon

Source: R/data.R
ex_recon_inputs.Rd

A synthetic but realistic complex focal amplification – a heavily rearranged CDK4 amplicon on chr12 (sample "EXAMPLE02") whose statistics are modelled on a real ecDNA amplicon: ~250 intra-chromosomal junctions (DEL/DUP/inversions) spanning read support from VF ~4 up to a VF-496 founder, over an oscillating copy-number profile (CN 15-35). So plot_sv_reconstruction() rebuilds it wave by wave from the founder down. karyotype / gene_coord fall back to the bundled hg38 references (CDK4 is labelled).

Usage

ex_recon_inputs

Format

A named list of three data.frames – cnv_data, sv_data, wgd_data – matching the columns plot_sv_reconstruction() expects (chr12, ~57.4-59.6 Mb around CDK4).

Source

Synthetic; generated by data-raw/make_example_data.R (statistics modelled on a real complex CDK4 amplicon, but all coordinates simulated).

See also

plot_sv_reconstruction(), ex_plot_inputs

Examples

p <- plot_sv_reconstruction(
  sample   = "EXAMPLE02",
  cnv_data = ex_recon_inputs$cnv_data,
  sv_data  = ex_recon_inputs$sv_data,
  wgd_data = ex_recon_inputs$wgd_data,
  chromosome = "chr12", chromosome_range = matrix(c(57e6, 60e6), nrow = 1),
  min_vf = 10
)
